_comment: The models Moly was tested with, newest first, per provider and role (fast: the small checks; reply: the text the user reads). A model is added only after scripts/approve_model.sh passes the live batteries on it. This table is a preference, not a requirement: a model that is listed and available wins; when none is, Moly picks the newest model of the right family from the provider's own list (tools.dynamicPick) and marks it untested, so a retired or new model never stops Moly.

fast.notes: live batteries and replay through the Claude CLI

reply.notes: reply role: judges premise/name answer/trait change/conflict answer 81/81 alone through the Claude CLI; 4 replays of the recorded conversation, no invented fact and no wrong owner of a relation (2 with Sonnet as the reply model). The full battery on it was spoiled by parallel use of the CLI and was not repeated. Not tried against the API with a key.
